routes.title: Junk Car FAQ: Titles, Free Towing & Pay | USJunkCars
routes.description: Can you sell a car without a title? How much do junkyards pay? Get clear answers about junking a car, free pickup, payment and paperwork.

mainEntity.name: How do I sell a junk car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Request an instant offer online or by phone, accept the price you see, choose a pickup time, and get paid when the tow truck collects the car. Most sellers finish the whole process in a day or two.

mainEntity.name: How much will you pay for my junk car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every offer is calculated for your vehicle. The year, make, model, condition, location and current scrap and parts prices all matter. A newer car with sellable parts usually earns more than its scrap weight alone.

mainEntity.name: How much do junkyards pay for cars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scrapyards mostly pay by weight, so the price follows scrap steel markets and changes week to week. Because our offers also count the value of reusable parts, they can beat a weight-only quote, and towing is included.

mainEntity.name: Is the offer guaranteed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your offer holds as long as the car matches what you described. If the driver finds something major that was not mentioned, such as a missing engine, the price may be adjusted before pickup. You can always decline.

mainEntity.name: Can I sell a car without a title?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, yes. Rules depend on your state and the age of the vehicle. Many states accept a current registration plus a photo ID, and older vehicles may need less. Tell us what paperwork you have and we will confirm before pickup.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a title to junk my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: A title makes it fastest, but it is not always required. If your title is lost, you can usually request a duplicate from your state DMV, or we can check whether your registration is enough.

mainEntity.name: What do I need to junk my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Have the title (or accepted alternative), a valid photo ID, and the keys if you have them. Remove your personal items and license plates before the driver arrives.

mainEntity.name: Can I sell a car that is still financed?

acceptedAnswer.text: If there is an active loan, the lender holds the title, so the loan must be paid off before the car can be sold for scrap. Contact your lender for a payoff amount first.

mainEntity.name: Is towing really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pickup is free and nothing is subtracted from your offer for towing, whether the car runs or not.

mainEntity.name: How fast can you pick up my car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most pickups happen within one to two days of accepting your offer, and same-day pickup is often possible. Your available time slots appear when you schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to be there during pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually someone needs to hand over the title and keys and sign the paperwork. If you cannot be present, tell us when you schedule and we will explain the options for your state.

mainEntity.name: How will I be paid?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are paid at pickup, when the driver collects the car. The payment method is shown when you schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do you buy cars that do not run?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We buy non-running cars, cars with blown engines or failed transmissions, and wrecked, flooded, burned or stripped vehicles.

mainEntity.name: How do I sell a car that does not run?

acceptedAnswer.text: Describe the problem honestly in the offer form. A car that does not start can still be worth more than scrap, and our tow truck handles cars that cannot move under their own power.

mainEntity.name: What should I do after the car is picked up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cancel your insurance, return or transfer the license plates as your state requires, and file a notice of sale or release of liability with your DMV if your state has one.
